units.name: Welsh Archers
units.description: Welsh Archers have longbowmen. Open Order. Inferior Fighters. May have shield (+2). May be given Evade (+2). Ambush (+2).

units.name: Welsh Spearmen
units.description: Welsh Spearmen have a spear and shield. Open Order. May exchange spear for javelins (+2) or throwing spear (+2). Every second unit may have light amrour (+2). May be given Evade (+2). Ambush (+2).

units.name: English Deserters
units.description: English Deserters have longbowmen and light armour. Open Order. There may be one unit of english deserters for every Men at Arms unit in the army.

units.name: Mounted Household Knights
units.description: Mounted Household Knights have heavy armour, spear and shield. Superior Fighters. Shock Cavalry. May have cloth barding (+1). May exchange spear for lance (+1).

units.name: Dismounted Household Knights
units.description: Dismounted Household Knights have heavy armour, spear and shield. Superior Fighters. May exchange spear for halberd (+2) or double handed weapon (+2).

units.name: Mounted Men at Arms

units.name: Dismounted Men at Arms

units.name: Skirmishers
units.description: Skirmishers have a javelin. Skirmishers. May have a shield (+1). May exchange javelins for bow (free).

units.name: Mounted Knights
units.description: Mounted Knights have partial plate armour, lance and shield. Superior Fighters. Impetuous. Shock Cavalry. Arrogant Pride. May have cloth barding (+1). May be Veteran (+1). If the army is led by the King, then one unit may be designated as Royal Bodyguard and be made Stubborn (+2). This unit must always be led by the King and cannot be in a Combined Unit with Mounted Retainers.

units.name: Foot Knights
units.description: Foot Knights have partial plate armour and spear. Superior Fighters. Riding Horses. May have have shield (+2), halberd (+2) or double handed weapon (+2). . May be Veteran (+2).

units.name: Combined Unit Mounted Knights/Retainers
units.description: Mounted Knights have partial plate armour, lance and shield. Superior Fighters. Impetuous. Shock Cavalry. Arrogant Pride. May have cloth barding (+1). May be Veteran (+1). Mounted Retainers have light armour, spear and shield. Impetuous. May have lance (+1). May have cloth barding (+1). May have heavy armour (+1). May exchange spear for lance (+1). Up to three quarters of the unit may be Mounted Retainers.

units.name: Combined Unit Foot Knights/Retainers
units.description: Foot Knights have partial plate armour and spear. Superior Fighters. Riding Horses. May have have shield (+2), halberd (+2) or double handed weapon (+2). . May be Veteran (+2). Foot Retainers have ligt armour and spear. Riding Horses.  May have shield (+2). May exchange spear for halberd (+2) or double handed weapon (+2) and may then have heavy armour (+2). Retainers form a Combined unit with Foot Knights. Up to three quarter sof the unit may be Foot Retainers.
